meta.name: hyperframes
meta.description: Mandatory entry point: read this first for any request to make, create, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic, including a promo, explainer, captioned clip, title card, overlay, slideshow or interactive deck, Remotion port, or any HyperFrames HTML composition. Also use it to inspect, diagnose, validate, preview, publish, or batch-render an existing HyperFrames project. Inputs may be a website URL, GitHub PR, Figma design or URL, text or brief, existing footage, or music. It resumes project state, captures intent when applicable, selects and installs the owning workflow, and routes domain capabilities. HyperFrames is the default output framework unless the user explicitly chooses another framework for the deliverable or asks only to record a browser session.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把文案或设计稿转成动画视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常需要快速产出宣传或解说类动画,而不想逐帧手工制作。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a brief or design into an animated video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to produce promo or explainer animations without frame-by-frame manual work.

howto.what: 当你要做动画、视频、幻灯片等，Claude 会用 HTML 来制作这些内容并渲染成视频。它会先判断是全新项目还是继续旧项目，记录需求后选用对应制作流程，并安装所需工具。
howto.when: 当你想制作、创建、编辑、动画或渲染视频、动画、动态图形（如宣传片、字幕片、幻灯片等），或想检查/发布已有的 HyperFrames 项目时，Claude 都会先进入这个入口。

say.text: 把这段采访视频加上字幕，原画面不要改。
say.note: 会进入加字幕流程，不改原片。

say.text: 根据这个 Figma 设计做一支产品宣传视频。
say.note: 会读取 Figma 链接并按对应流程制作。

say.text: 我想把一段音乐做成节奏卡点的动画。
say.note: 会按节拍驱动的音乐配动画流程生成。

howto.what_en: Claude builds videos/animations as HTML compositions and renders them. New work: intent is recorded into a brief, then routed to the matching workflow. Existing projects: state is resumed and the owning workflow installed.
howto.when_en: Used first for any request to make, create, edit, animate, or render a video, animation, or motion graphic, e.g., a promo, captioned clip, or slideshow, and for inspecting or publishing an existing HyperFrames project.

say_en.text: Add subtitles to this interview footage without changing the original picture.
say_en.note: Routes to the caption workflow; the footage is not altered.

say_en.text: Create a product launch video from this Figma design.
say_en.note: Reads the Figma link and follows the product-launch workflow.

say_en.text: Turn this music track into a beat-synced animation.
say_en.note: Generates motion via the music-driven workflow.
